PDF Point-Tessellated Voxelization
In the case of binary voxelization, we simply output a constant value for each point in the pixel shader to indicate occupancy. Nonetheless, many applications may store the scalars or vectors contained in the triangles (colors, normals, etc.) into the voxels (called Multi-valued Voxelization).
